description_en: Queries the statistics of historical events in the event center
description_zh: 统计事件中心的历史事件
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-history-events-stat --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --archive-status Archived --from-start-time 2022-01-02T11:31:03Z --to-start-time 2022-03-02T11:31:03Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHistoryEventsStat

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The status of the asset instance. Valid values: **starting**, **running**, **stopping**, and **stopped**.
parameters.description_zh:
事件状态。取值说明：
- **Archived**：已归档
- **UnArchived**：未归档
- **All**：所有

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Only tasks that have a start time later than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The start time can be up to 30 days earlier than the current time. If you set this parameter to a time more than 30 days earlier than the current time, this time is automatically converted to a time that is exactly 30 days earlier than the current time.
parameters.description_zh: 任务开始时间的起始时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之后的任务。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。最早支持30天前，距当前时间超过30天会自动转换成30天前。
